name: Marketing
description: Turns a product shortlist into a paid-social campaign the human still has to press play on. Registers Meta's own hosted Ads MCP server (mcp.facebook.com/ads) as a gateway upstream with your access token, and adds four deterministic, network-free tools of its own — score a catalog against a collection hint, draft a campaign plan, build a validated carousel creative, and keep an append-only ledger of what was launched. It never creates a campaign (Meta's tools do) and never reads a catalog (the store's app does); campaigns are always created PAUSED and activated by a human in Ads Manager.

skills.description: The catalog → shortlist → plan → creative → PAUSED campaign flow: which tools to call in which order, why the store's `search` tool must never be used, and the hard stop after a campaign is created (send the Ads Manager link, never activate).

Operating Meta's hosted Ads MCP (the meta-ads upstream, ads_* tools): the campaign → ad set → creative → ad call order with minimum payloads, why a video creative needs a thumbnail as well as a video_id, why ads_update_entity replaces targeting instead of merging it, how Advantage+ rewrites targeting and copy unannounced, the API media-upload gate and its UI workaround, and where the Meta access token and every config value live. Load before the first ads_* call.

agent_configs.name: Marketing
agent_configs.description: Tool belt for the marketing agent: this app's own deterministic tools, Meta's hosted Ads MCP, and the store app's catalog upstream. The store credential is never duplicated here — it is reached through the gateway, owned by whichever app registered that store.

agents.name: Marketing - Sonnet
agents.description: Monta campanhas pagas no Instagram/Facebook a partir do catálogo da loja — seleciona produtos, monta plano e criativo, cria a campanha PAUSADA na Meta e devolve o link do Ads Manager para um humano ativar.
agents.capabilities: Builds paid social campaigns from a store catalog: picks products for a collection, drafts plan and carousel creative, creates the campaign PAUSED via Meta's own Ads MCP, records it in an audit ledger, and hands the Ads Manager link to a human. Never activates a campaign or changes a budget.

meta_access_token.description: Meta access token with the ads_mcp_management permission, used as the Bearer credential for the hosted https://mcp.facebook.com/ads upstream. Generated once in the Meta app dashboard (App ID 111891037126607 for Crispal); user tokens expire after ~60 days. Never stored in plain config — routed to the encrypted secret store via POST /api/apps/marketing/settings, same pattern as aw-app-notion's notion_token / aw-app-git's github_token. Empty means the meta-ads upstream is registered DISABLED and every Meta-side step reports 'not configured' instead of 401-ing with zero tools.

meta_ad_account_id.description: Ad account the campaigns are created in, e.g. act_1234567890. Also what builds the Ads Manager link handed back to the human. The account needs a payment method or campaign creation fails even in PAUSED.

meta_page_id.description: Facebook Page id that owns the ad creative (object_story_spec.page_id). Required by Meta for any ad creative.

meta_instagram_actor_id.description: Instagram business account id the ad runs as. Required when the plan's platform is 'instagram'; ignored otherwise.

default_daily_budget_minor.description: Default daily budget in MINOR currency units (cents), e.g. 500 = 5.00. 0 means unset — marketing_campaign_plan then requires an explicit daily_budget argument instead of inventing one.

default_country.description: Default two-letter targeting country, e.g. PT. Empty means unset — marketing_campaign_plan requires an explicit country argument instead of guessing where to spend money.

default_currency.description: Default ISO currency of the budget, e.g. EUR. Informational — the ad account's own currency is authoritative on Meta's side; this only labels the plan a human reads.
